Any such disclosure—

intentional or otherwise—shall render the concerned bid liable for immediate rej ection for that particular schedule or the entire bidding process, as applicable. This clause is non-negotiable and is aimed at preserving the sanctity and impar tiality of the technical evaluation process. Clause 2: Abnormally Low Quoted Amounts and Disqualification To uphold the principles of fair competition and to prevent any attempt to secur e L1 status through non-bonafide practices, it is hereby stipulated that: If any item within a schedule is quoted at an abnormally low price (e.g., ₹1 or any other value significantly below reasonable market rates), the respec tive evaluation committee shall have the discretion to examine the quotati on for its reasonableness. In such cases, a one-time opportunity for justification shall be provided to t he concerned bidder(s) through the GeM portal. The bidder must furnish a valid and satisfactory explanation or cost breakup justifying the quoted pri ce within the specified timeline. Failure to submit such justification, the inability to provide at that price, or submission of an inadequate/unsatisfactory justification may result in the r ejection of the quoted item(s) and disqualification of the bid for that partic ular schedule or the entire tender, as deemed appropriate by the Compete nt Authority. The decision of the Evaluation Committee/Competent Authority in this rega rd shall be final and binding, and no further correspondence shall be entert ained. Clause 3: Rejection of Bids in Case of Identical IP Address In order to ensure transparency and fairness in the bidding process, it is hereby stipulated that if two or more bids are found to have been submitted from the s ame IP address, such bids shall be treated as non-compliant and shall be summ arily rejected without any further consideration. As per CAG, “Placing of more than one bid for the same tender from the same I P address more often than not shows that the same computer was used to plac e the bids and is an indicator for collusion among bidders.” This provision is aimed at preventing collusive bidding or any attempt to manip ulate the procurement process. The decision of the Competent Authority in this regard shall be final and binding. Clause 4: Mandatory Submission of Compliance Sheet with Manufactur er Details To ensure authenticity and traceability of the materials, the seller shall provide a schedule-wise compliance sheet on the signed letterhead of the firm a t the time of bid submission. The compliance sheet must clearly indicate: Name of the manufacturer of the chemical/plasticware/glassware/materia l, Corresponding catalogue number / product ID, and Confirmation of adherence to the required specifications through CoA {Cer tificate of Analysis} (which can be verified by the technical committee) or Product literature attached with the technical bid verifiable online.

Failure to submit any/all compliance documentation in the prescribed format m ay render the bid liable for rejection at the technical evaluation stage itself. Note: The final order shall be placed only on those bidders who submit bids for and affirm their capability and willingn ess to supply all items covered under the respective schedu le/package/BOQ in entirety. Partial quoting or non-confirma tion for supply of all scheduled items may render the bid lia ble for rejection at the sole discretion of the Buyer. The bidder shall quote their prices strictly on schedule-wise basis as specified in the tender document. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of ICAR Unit PD on FMD, SBI, Jatni Branch Code 2071 A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name ICAR-Unit PD on FMD Account No. 11576142063 IFSC Code SBIN0002071 Bank Name State Bank of India Branch address Jatni, Branch Code - 2071 . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract.
